name: case-cell-shop
description: Monorepo do desafio técnico Fullstack Pleno CaseCellShop.

scripts.postinstall: npm run build --workspace @case-cell-shop/contracts && npm run prisma:generate
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @case-cell-shop/contracts && npm run build --workspace @case-cell-shop/api && npm run build --workspace @case-cell-shop/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @case-cell-shop/contracts && npm run test --workspace @case-cell-shop/api && npm run test --workspace @case-cell-shop/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @case-cell-shop/contracts && npm run build --workspace @case-cell-shop/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace @case-cell-shop/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @case-cell-shop/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @case-cell-shop/contracts && npm run lint --workspace @case-cell-shop/api && npm run lint --workspace @case-cell-shop/web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
